input.overview: Escape is a target-and-lane game built around E-S-C-A-P-E, the drop targets, and the Turbo hole. Pass the upper lanes and orange rollovers until every ESCAPE letter has been lit twice to light Escape Special. Complete every drop target to raise Bonus X through 5x. When 50,000 is lit, shoot the Turbo hole to light Turbo Special; the ADV TURBO SPINNER and BOOST BALL features provide the alternate setup.
input.simpleOverview: In Escape, pass the upper lanes and orange rollovers until every ESCAPE letter has been lit twice to light Escape Special. Complete every drop target to raise Bonus X through 5x. For Turbo Special, shoot the Turbo hole while 50,000 is lit, or use BOOST BALL when ADV TURBO SPINNER is lit before returning to the hole.
input.summary: Build the steady value first by completing the drop targets for Bonus X. Add E-S-C-A-P-E progress whenever the upper lanes are available, then use the Turbo hole only when its 50,000 or Special setup is ready.

quickInfo.name: Light Escape Special
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the upper lanes and orange rollovers until every E-S-C-A-P-E letter is lit twice.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete all drop targets for 2x, then repeat for 3x, 4x, and 5x.

quickInfo.name: Light Turbo Special
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the Turbo hole when its 50,000 value is lit.

quickInfo.name: Alternate Turbo setup
quickInfo.summary: Hit BOOST BALL while ADV TURBO SPINNER is lit, then return to the Turbo hole.

steps.text: Complete every drop target to raise the end-of-ball bonus multiplier from 2x through 5x.
Pass the upper lanes and orange rollovers to light E-S-C-A-P-E; light the full word twice to turn on Escape Special.
Watch the Turbo-hole value and shoot the hole when 50,000 is lit to turn on Turbo Special.
As an alternate Turbo route, hit BOOST BALL while ADV TURBO SPINNER is lit, then return to the Turbo hole.

alternatives.title: Bonus-first route
alternatives.when: Use this when the complete drop-target set is more available than the upper lanes.

steps.text: Finish the drop targets for the next Bonus X level.
Take upper-lane and orange-rollover progress when the ball reaches the top.
Delay the Turbo hole until 50,000 or the ADV TURBO SPINNER setup is lit.

buildsToward.title: 5x Bonus, Escape Special, and Turbo Special

steps.text: Repeat full drop-target completions to reach 5x Bonus.
Shoot the upper lanes and orange rollovers until all six ESCAPE letters are lit twice for Escape Special.
Shoot the Turbo hole at 50,000, or use the BOOST BALL setup, for Turbo Special.

machineSetup: Confirm that every upper lane and orange rollover advances the intended ESCAPE letter, every drop target registers and resets, and the Turbo hole ejects cleanly.
Check the ADV TURBO SPINNER, BOOST BALL, 50,000, Escape Special, and Turbo Special lamps before choosing a route.
